name: Adjudications metrics (live data)
description: Reports providing various metrics relating to the adjudications service.

dataset.name: Adjudication status statistics / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name from(select
    CAST(date_trunc('month', create_datetime) AS DATE) AS month_year,
 format_datetime(min(create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS min_date, format_datetime(max(create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS max_date,
    COALESCE(originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
    count(charge_number) as charges,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'ADJOURNED') as adjourned,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'AWAITING_REVIEW') as awaiting_review,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'CHARGE_PROVED') as charge_proved,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'DISMISSED') as dismissed,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'INVALID_ADA') as invalid_ada,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'INVALID_OUTCOME') as invalid_outcome,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'INVALID_SUSPENDED') as invalid_suspended,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'NOT_PROCEED') as not_proceed,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'PROSECUTION') as prosecution,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'QUASHED') as quashed,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REFER_GOV') as refer_gov,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REFER_INAD') as refer_inad,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REFER_POLICE') as refer_police,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REJECTED') as rejected,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'RETURNED') as returned,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'SCHEDULED') as scheduled,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'UNSCHEDULED') as unscheduled,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REJECTED' and status_reason = 'expired') as rejected_expired,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REJECTED' and status_reason = 'unsuitable') as rejected_unsuitable,
    count(id) filter (where status = 'REJECTED' and status_reason = 'alternative') as rejected_alternative
from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications
group by 1, ROLLUP(originating_agency_id)) as result
 LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Punishment statistics / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name from(select
    CAST(date_trunc('month', p.create_datetime) AS DATE) AS month,
    format_datetime(min(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS min_date, format_datetime(max(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS max_date,
    COALESCE(ra.originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
    count(distinct(reported_adjudication_fk_id)) as adjudications,
    count(id) as puns,
    count(id) filter ( where suspended_until is null ) as unsuspended_puns,
    count(id) filter ( where suspended_until is not null ) as suspended_puns,
    count(id) filter ( where consecutive_to_charge_number is not null ) as consecutive_puns,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'CAUTION' ) as cautions,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'CONFINEMENT' ) as confinements,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'PRIVILEGE' ) as privilege,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'DAMAGES_OWED' ) as damages_owed,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'EARNINGS' ) as earnings,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'PAYBACK' ) as payback,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS' ) as add_days_added,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS' ) as pros_days_added,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' ) as loss_social_visits,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' ) as res_social_visits,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'EXCLUSION_WORK' ) as exclusion_work,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'EXTRA_WORK' ) as extra_work,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'REMOVAL_ACTIVITY' ) as removal_activity,
    count(id) filter ( where type = 'REMOVAL_WING' ) as removal_wing
from dps_adjudications.public.punishment as p
left join (select id as ra_id, originating_agency_id from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications) as ra
on p.reported_adjudication_fk_id = ra.ra_id
where p.deleted is null
group by 1, ROLLUP(ra.originating_agency_id)) as result
 LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Privilege Punishments / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name 
from(select CAST(date_trunc('month', p.create_datetime) AS DATE) AS month_year,
         format_datetime(min(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS min_date, format_datetime(max(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS max_date,
         COALESCE(ra.originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
         COALESCE(privilege_type, 'All privilege types') as privilege_type,
         count(id) as num_priv_puns,
         count(CASE WHEN duration > 42 THEN id END) as num_over_42_days,
         count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 43 AND 63 THEN id END) as num_between_43_63_days,
         count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 64 AND 74 THEN id END) as num_between_64_74_days,
         count(CASE WHEN duration > 74 THEN id END) as num_more_than_74_days,
         max(duration) as max_days_added
  from dps_adjudications.public.punishment as p
           left join (select punishment_fk_id, duration from dps_adjudications.public.punishment_schedule) as ps
                     on p.id = ps.punishment_fk_id
           left join (select id as ra_id, originating_agency_id from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications) as ra
                     on p.reported_adjudication_fk_id = ra.ra_id
  where deleted is null and type = 'PRIVILEGE'
  group by 1, ROLLUP(ra.originating_agency_id), ROLLUP(privilege_type)) as result
     LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Days added / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name from(select CAST(date_trunc('month', p.create_datetime) AS DATE) AS month_year, format_datetime(min(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS min_date, format_datetime(max(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS max_date,
       COALESCE(ra.originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
       count(id) filter(where type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS') as num_ada_puns,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 42 AND type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_ada_over_42_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 43 AND 63 AND type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_ada_between_43_63_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_ada_between_64_74_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 74 AND type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_ada_more_than_74_days,
       max(duration) filter(where type = 'ADDITIONAL_DAYS') as max_add_days_added,
       count(id) filter(where type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS') as num_pda_puns,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 42 AND type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_pda_over_42_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 43 AND 63 AND type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_pda_between_43_63_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_pda_between_64_74_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 74 AND type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS' THEN id END) as num_pda_more_than_74_days,
       max(duration) filter(where type = 'PROSPECTIVE_DAYS') as max_pros_days_added
from dps_adjudications.public.punishment as p
    left join (select punishment_fk_id, duration from dps_adjudications.public.punishment_schedule) as ps
on p.id = ps.punishment_fk_id
    left join (select id as ra_id, originating_agency_id from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications) as ra
    on p.reported_adjudication_fk_id = ra.ra_id
where deleted is null
group by 1, ROLLUP(ra.originating_agency_id)) as result
 LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Visits punishments / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name from(select CAST(date_trunc('month', p.create_datetime) AS DATE) AS month_year, format_datetime(min(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS min_date, format_datetime(max(p.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS max_date,
       COALESCE(ra.originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
       count(id) filter(where type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS') as num_loss_puns,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 42 AND type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_loss_over_42_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 43 AND 63 AND type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_loss_between_43_63_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_loss_between_64_74_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 74 AND type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_loss_more_than_74_days,
       max(duration) filter(where type = 'LOSS_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS') as max_loss_days,
       count(id) filter(where type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS') as num_res_puns,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 42 AND type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_res_over_42_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 43 AND 63 AND type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_res_between_43_63_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_res_between_64_74_days,
       count(CASE WHEN duration > 74 AND type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS' THEN id END) as num_res_more_than_74_days,
       max(duration) filter(where type = 'RESTRICTION_OF_SOCIAL_VISITS') as max_res_days
from dps_adjudications.public.punishment as p
         left join (select punishment_fk_id, duration from dps_adjudications.public.punishment_schedule) as ps
                   on p.id = ps.punishment_fk_id
         left join (select id as ra_id, originating_agency_id from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications) as ra
                   on p.reported_adjudication_fk_id = ra.ra_id
where deleted is null
group by 1, ROLLUP(ra.originating_agency_id)
order by month_year desc, location_id) as result
 LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Rehabilitation activity statistics / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name from(select
    CAST(date_trunc('month', date_time_of_first_hearing) AS DATE) AS month,
    COALESCE(result.originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
    count(reported_adjudication_fk_id) as num_adjs,
    sum(num_punishments) as total_punishments,
    sum(num_suspended_punishments) as total_suspended_punishments,
    sum(num_rehab_activities) as total_rehab_activities,
    count(reported_adjudication_fk_id) filter( where all_pun_suspended = 'Y') as num_charges_all_pun_suspended,
    ROUND(sum(num_rehab_activities) / NULLIF(sum(num_punishments),0) * 100, 1) as per_pun_have_rehab,
    ROUND(sum(num_rehab_activities) / NULLIF(sum(num_suspended_punishments),0) * 100, 1) as per_sus_pun_have_rehab,
    ROUND(CAST(count(all_sus_pun_have_rehab) filter(where all_sus_pun_have_rehab = 'Y') as DECIMAL(18,2)) / NULLIF(CAST(count(reported_adjudication_fk_id) filter(where num_rehab_activities > 0) as DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) * 100, 1) as per_adjs_with_all_sus_pun_have_rehab,
    ROUND(CAST(count(all_rehab_same) filter(where all_rehab_same = 'Y') as DECIMAL(18,2)) / NULLIF(CAST(count(reported_adjudication_fk_id) filter(where num_rehab_activities > 1) as DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) * 100, 1) as per_adjs_with_all_sus_pun_have_same_rehab
from (select *,
           CASE WHEN pun_result.num_suspended_punishments = num_punishments THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as all_pun_suspended,
           CASE WHEN pun_result.num_suspended_punishments = num_rehab_activities AND pun_result.num_suspended_punishments > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as all_sus_pun_have_rehab,
           CASE WHEN num_unique_rehab_activities = 1 and num_rehab_activities > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as all_rehab_same
    from (
        select reported_adjudication_fk_id,
               count(p.id) as num_punishments,
               count(CASE WHEN p.suspended_until is not null Then p.id END) as num_suspended_punishments,
               count(r.ra_id) as num_rehab_activities,
               count(DISTINCT(CONCAT(r.details, r.monitor, CAST(r.end_date as varchar), CAST(r.total_sessions as varchar)))) filter(where r.ra_id is not null) as num_unique_rehab_activities
        from dps_adjudications.public.punishment as p
        left join (select rehabilitative_activity.punishment_fk_id, id as ra_id, details, monitor, end_date, total_sessions from dps_adjudications.public.rehabilitative_activity ) as r
        on r.punishment_fk_id = p.id
        where p.deleted is null
        group by p.reported_adjudication_fk_id) as pun_result
    left join (select id as adj_id, date_time_of_first_hearing, originating_agency_id from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications) as adj
    on pun_result.reported_adjudication_fk_id = adj.adj_id) as result
group by 1, ROLLUP(originating_agency_id)) as result
 LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Hearing outcomes / location
dataset.query:
select result.*, COALESCE(pr.name, 'All locations') as location_name from(select
    CAST(date_trunc('month', o.create_datetime) AS DATE) AS month_year,
    format_datetime(min(o.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS min_date, format_datetime(max(o.create_datetime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS max_date,
    COALESCE(ra.originating_agency_id, 'All locations') as location_id,
    count(distinct(reported_adjudication_fk_id)) as adjudications,
    count(id) as total_outcomes,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'CHARGE_PROVED' ) as charge_proved,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'DISMISSED' ) as dismissed,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'NOT_PROCEED' ) as not_proceed,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'PROSECUTION' ) as prosecution,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'QUASHED' ) as quashed,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'REFER_GOV' ) as refer_gov,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'REFER_INAD' ) as refer_inad,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'REFER_POLICE' ) as refer_police,
    count(id) filter ( where code = 'SCHEDULE_HEARING' ) as schedule_hearing,
    count(id) filter ( where quashed_reason = 'APPEAL_UPHELD' ) as quashed_appeal_upheld,
    count(id) filter ( where quashed_reason = 'FLAWED_CASE' ) as quashed_flawed_case,
    count(id) filter ( where quashed_reason = 'JUDICIAL_REVIEW' ) as quashed_judicial_review,
    count(id) filter ( where quashed_reason = 'OTHER' ) as quashed_other,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'ANOTHER_WAY' ) as not_proceed_another_way,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'EXPIRED_HEARING' ) as not_proceed_expired_hearing,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'EXPIRED_NOTICE' ) as not_proceed_expired_notice,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'FLAWED' ) as not_proceed_flawed,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'NOT_FAIR' ) as not_proceed_not_fair,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'OTHER' ) as not_proceed_other,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'RELEASED' ) as not_proceed_released,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'UNFIT' ) as not_proceed_unfit,
    count(id) filter ( where not_proceed_reason = 'WITNESS_NOT_ATTEND' ) as not_proceed_witness_not_attend
from dps_adjudications.public.outcome as o
left join (select id as ra_id, originating_agency_id from dps_adjudications.public.reported_adjudications) as ra
on o.reported_adjudication_fk_id = ra.ra_id
where deleted is null
group by 1, ROLLUP(ra.originating_agency_id)) as result
 LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison as pr ON pr.prison_id = result.location_id

dataset.name: Prisons
dataset.query:
select prison_id, name prison_name FROM prisons.prisonregister_prison p where p.active = true 
UNION ALL SELECT 'All locations' as prison_id, 'All locations' as name

dataset.name: Privilege types
dataset.query:
select DISTINCT(privilege_type) as privilege_type FROM dps_adjudications.public.punishment
UNION ALL SELECT 'All privilege types' as privilege_type
